verdict.rationale: Docs point to visibility into company progress, burndown/cycle-time charts, and multiple views (boards, lists, timeline, calendar) that support progress reporting, and JQL/REST querying is praised by community members for building custom reports. However, no evidence explicitly documents a dashboard/widget builder (e.g., customizable gadgets) or confirms ease of assembling multi-project reporting views. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dashboard/widget creation feature, independent hands-on validation of building such dashboards, and confirmation of ease-of-use for report/dashboard configuration.
